items.title: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is now generally available: Go from idea to production-grade agent in minutes
items.raw_excerpt: Today, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is generally available. Two API calls (CreateHarness to define an agent, and InvokeHarness to run it), and you have an agent running in seconds. The agent runs in its own isolated environment with a filesystem and shell, so it can read files, run commands, and write code safely. It remembers users and conversations across sessions, picks up skills you point it at (including the AWS-curated catalog), browses the web, calls your tools through gateway or MCP, and switches model providers mid-session without losing context. Every step streams back to you in real time and is automatically traced to Amazon CloudWatch. You don’t need to write orchestration code or build a container, unless you want to.

title_i18n.en: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is now generally available: Go from idea to production-grade agent in minutes
title_i18n.zh: Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Harness现已全面可用：几分钟内从创意到生产级智能体
title_i18n.es: El arnés Amazon Bedrock AgentCore ya está disponible de forma general: pasa de una idea a un agente de nivel de producción en cuestión de minutos.

excerpt_i18n.en: Today, Amazon Bedrock AgentCore harness is generally available. Two API calls (CreateHarness to define an agent, and InvokeHarness to run it), and you have an agent running in seconds. The agent runs in its own isolated environment with a filesystem and shell, so it can read files, run commands, and write code safely. It remembers users and conversations across sessions, picks up skills you point it at (including the AWS-curated catalog), browses the web, calls your tools through gateway or MCP, and switches model providers mid-session without losing context. Every step streams back to you in real time and is automatically traced to Amazon CloudWatch. You don’t need to write orchestration code or build a container, unless you want to.
excerpt_i18n.zh: 今天，Amazon Bedrock AgentCore 工具正式上线。通过两次 API 调用（CreateHarness 定义代理，InvokeHarness 运行代理），即可在数秒内启动一个代理。该代理在其独立的隔离环境中运行。
excerpt_i18n.es: Hoy, el arnés AgentCore de Amazon Bedrock está disponible de forma general. Dos llamadas a la API (CreateHarness para definir un agente e InvokeHarness para ejecutarlo) y tendrás un agente funcionando en segundos. El agente se ejecuta en su propio entorno aislado.

items.title: It Is Trivially Easy to Use Reddit to Manipulate AI Search
items.raw_excerpt: "We show that a tiny snippet—just 13 words—of retrieved text on a UGC website like Reddit, Wikipedia, Quora, or Facebook can change AI agents to output spam / scam content pretty consistently."

title_i18n.en: It Is Trivially Easy to Use Reddit to Manipulate AI Search
title_i18n.zh: 使用Reddit操纵AI搜索简直轻而易举。
title_i18n.es: Es trivialmente fácil usar Reddit para manipular la búsqueda de IA.

excerpt_i18n.en: "We show that a tiny snippet—just 13 words—of retrieved text on a UGC website like Reddit, Wikipedia, Quora, or Facebook can change AI agents to output spam / scam content pretty consistently."
excerpt_i18n.zh: 我们证明，在Reddit、维基百科、Quora或Facebook等UGC网站上，仅检索到13个单词的极短文本片段，就能相当稳定地诱使AI智能体输出垃圾或诈骗内容。
excerpt_i18n.es: Demostramos que un pequeño fragmento—apenas 13 palabras—de texto recuperado en un sitio web de contenido generado por usuarios como Reddit, Wikipedia, Quora o Facebook puede hacer que los agentes de IA generen contenido de spam o estafa de manera bastante consistente.

title_i18n.en: Barret Zoph is out at OpenAI again after just five months
title_i18n.zh: 巴雷特·佐夫在仅五个月后再次离开OpenAI。
title_i18n.es: Barret Zoph ha vuelto a salir de OpenAI tras solo cinco meses.

excerpt_i18n.en: Five months after returning to OpenAI, Barret Zoph - the company's head of enterprise AI sales - has departed, The Verge has learned. Zoph returned to OpenAI in mid-January after a stint as co-founder and CTO of Thinking Machines Lab, the competing AI company founded by former OpenAI CTO Mira Murati. Shortly after Zoph returned […]
excerpt_i18n.zh: The Verge获悉，OpenAI企业AI销售负责人Barret Zoph在重返公司五个月后离职。Zoph曾担任Thinking公司联合创始人兼首席技术官，于今年1月中旬回归OpenAI。
excerpt_i18n.es: Cinco meses después de regresar a OpenAI, Barret Zoph, el responsable de ventas de IA empresarial de la compañía, ha dejado la empresa, según ha sabido The Verge. Zoph regresó a OpenAI a mediados de enero tras un período como cofundador y director de tecnología de Thinking.
